t: Alfred Vail和同事用点和破折号(这是Morse代码的前身)演示电报系统.
te: Alfred Vail and colleagues demonstrate a telegraph system using dots and dashes (this is the forerunner of Morse code).
dz: Alfred Vail和同事用点和破折号(这是Morse代码的前身)演示电报系统.
de: Alfred Vail and colleagues demonstrate a telegraph system using dots and dashes (this is the forerunner of Morse code).

t: 在维能大屠杀中,布拉克兰河一带有上百名伏特里克克人被祖鲁斯所杀.
te: In the Weenen massacre, hundreds of Voortrekkers along the Blaukraans River, Natal are killed by Zulus.
dz: 在维能大屠杀中,布拉克兰河一带有上百名伏特里克克人被祖鲁斯所杀.
de: In the Weenen massacre, hundreds of Voortrekkers along the Blaukraans River, Natal are killed by Zulus.

t: 法国军队在糕点战争中占领韦拉克鲁斯。
te: The French Army captures Veracruz in the Pastry War.
dz: 法国军队在糕点战争中占领韦拉克鲁斯。
de: The French Army captures Veracruz in the Pastry War.

t: 尼加拉瓜宣布从中美洲联邦独立。
te: Nicaragua declares independence from the Central American Federation.
dz: 尼加拉瓜宣布从中美洲联邦独立。
de: Nicaragua declares independence from the Central American Federation.

dz: Myall Creek大屠杀:28名澳大利亚原住民被谋杀.
de: Myall Creek massacre: Twenty-eight Aboriginal Australians are murdered.

t: 英国维多利亚女王加冕.
te: Coronation of Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom.
dz: 英国维多利亚女王加冕.
de: Coronation of Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom.

t: 拉尔夫·瓦尔多·爱默生在哈佛神学院(英语:Harvard Divinity School)递交…
te: Ralph Waldo Emerson delivers the Divinity School Address at Harvard Divinity School, discounting Biblical miracles and …
dz: 拉尔夫·瓦尔多·爱默生在哈佛神学院(英语:Harvard Divinity School)递交了神学院的演讲稿,忽略了圣经奇迹并宣布耶稣为伟人,但并非上帝. 新教社区的反应令人愤慨.
de: Ralph Waldo Emerson delivers the Divinity School Address at Harvard Divinity School, discounting Biblical miracles and declaring Jesus a great man, but not God. The Protestant community reacts with outrage.

t: 威尔克斯远征军将探索普吉特之声和南极洲,重起锚于汉普顿道.
te: The Wilkes Expedition, which would explore the Puget Sound and Antarctica, weighs anchor at Hampton Roads.
dz: 威尔克斯远征军将探索普吉特之声和南极洲,重起锚于汉普顿道.
de: The Wilkes Expedition, which would explore the Puget Sound and Antarctica, weighs anchor at Hampton Roads.

t: 圣安德鲁苏格兰人学校(Saint Andrew's Scoters School)是南美洲英国…
te: Saint Andrew's Scots School, the oldest school of British origin in South America, is established.
dz: 圣安德鲁苏格兰人学校(Saint Andrew's Scoters School)是南美洲英国血统最古老的学校,已经建立.
de: Saint Andrew's Scots School, the oldest school of British origin in South America, is established.

t: 未来的废奴主义者弗雷德里克·道格拉斯从奴隶制中逃脱.
te: Future abolitionist Frederick Douglass escapes from slavery.
dz: 未来的废奴主义者弗雷德里克·道格拉斯从奴隶制中逃脱.
de: Future abolitionist Frederick Douglass escapes from slavery.

t: 反冕法会由理查德·科布登所建立.
te: The Anti-Corn Law League is established by Richard Cobden.
dz: 反冕法会由理查德·科布登所建立.
de: The Anti-Corn Law League is established by Richard Cobden.

t: 密苏里州长利尔本·博格斯(Lilburn Boggs)发布"灭绝令",命令所有摩门教徒离开州或…
te: Missouri governor Lilburn Boggs issues the Extermination Order, which orders all Mormons to leave the state or be kille…
dz: 密苏里州长利尔本·博格斯(Lilburn Boggs)发布"灭绝令",命令所有摩门教徒离开州或被杀死.
de: Missouri governor Lilburn Boggs issues the Extermination Order, which orders all Mormons to leave the state or be killed.

t: 印度"泰晤士报"(英语:The Times of India),是世界上发行量最大的英文日报"…
te: The Times of India, the world's largest circulated English language daily broadsheet newspaper is founded as The Bombay…
dz: 印度"泰晤士报"(英语:The Times of India),是世界上发行量最大的英文日报"宽单"报纸,创办于"孟买时报"和"商报".
de: The Times of India, the world's largest circulated English language daily broadsheet newspaper is founded as The Bombay Times and Journal of Commerce.

t: 血河之战:由安德里斯·普雷托里乌斯和萨雷尔·西利耶斯所率领的伏特里克克人击败了由达姆布扎(恩佐…
te: Battle of Blood River: Voortrekkers led by Andries Pretorius and Sarel Cilliers defeat Zulu impis, led by Dambuza (Nzob…
dz: 大特里克:血河之战:由安德里斯·普雷托里乌斯和萨雷尔·西利耶斯所率领的伏特里克克人击败了由达姆布扎(恩佐波)和恩德莱拉·卡·松皮西所率领的祖鲁·普里伊斯(英语:Zulu impis (Nzobo)),今天在南非克瓦祖鲁-纳塔尔地区.
de: Great Trek: Battle of Blood River: Voortrekkers led by Andries Pretorius and Sarel Cilliers defeat Zulu impis, led by Dambuza (Nzobo) and Ndlela kaSompisi in what is today KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
